The new batch therefore emphasizes paired response curves and loading contrasts in the tail-prone families, adds the aminobenzonitrile positional pair, and preserves three compact high-strength controls.","batch_rationale":"The batch repairs several observed failure regions while keeping the experiments structured. Extended aromatic, sulfur-containing, nitro, heteroaromatic, donor-rich, and aminoaromatic families receive high-condition or high-loading points because measured records show large V1/V2 underprediction in these regimes. Multiple same-family pairs and triplets test solvent-strength curvature, onset thresholds, and loading effects, which should improve interpolation across the Row-distribution. The m160/m161 pair targets positional graph-context transfer directly. Compact m136, m57, and m48 controls provide counterexamples at strong composition so retraining can learn where long-tail corrections should stop. Together these labels cover endpoint expansion, endpoint-specific V2 behavior, local chemical context, loading interactions, and failure boundaries without optimizing the chromatography of any selected experiment."}
